description: Search spreadsheet expenses by category, merchant, dates, amount or tags. When hasMore, reuse nextCursor with identical filters; avoid overlapping ranges. Optional query does deterministic non-embedding recall over merchant, city/location, Notes (receipt items, delivery source, payer, business purpose), Tag and category; ANDed with structured filters. Results include matchedFields, matchReason and exact expenseId (durable Receipt ID for update_expense). paymentStatus is bookkeeping only, never bank settlement proof. Card/account nicknames: includePaidWith:true (page labels only; cannot filter). Country/client review: groupBy:country needs explicit YYYY-MM-DD bounds, at most 100 matches; narrow oversized ranges; allows categories/merchants/tags/countries/tagAssignment, no query or pagination. Use configured travel categories; foreign locations do not prove travel. Keep unknown countries separate; ask about ambiguous places, never infer from currency. Show counts and per-currency totals; give selectionItems to group_expenses once a destination is chosen.

countries.description: Country names/codes, or unknown; never infer from currency or an ambiguous city.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page; reuse the same filters; never edit.

dateRange.description: Requested period; YYYY year; inclusive YYYY-MM-DD bounds.

groupBy.description: Read-only country review; needs explicit dateRange.start/end.

hasReceipt.description: True: attached receipt only. False: none ("No receipt" text is none, not a tag).

includePaidWith.description: Page labels only; unavailable differs from blank.

missing.description: Expenses Review counts as missing that label; Personal needs no tag.

paymentStatus.description: Bookkeeping filter, not bank settlement; ordinary search only.

query.description: Optional keyword recall over the fields in the tool description.

tagAssignment.description: Country review: unassigned = blank/Business; no_client = no client tag. Neither implies business use.

view.description: Review view from saved report choices. tax_deductible: business only.

name: search_expenses

countryGroups.description: Bounded country review; unknown locations stay separate.

expenses.description: Matching expense rows, newest first, paginated.

nextCursor.description: Opaque signed continuation; reuse with identical filters.

total.description: Home-currency sum; null in country review. Use countryGroups totalsByCurrency, never sum currencies.
